ios.desc:
PocketCI puts your CircleCI projects on your iPhone - clean, fast and built for real debugging, not just dashboards.

FOLLOW EVERY PROJECT
See all projects in your organizations, not just the ones you follow. Search by project or org, sort by name, and jump straight into the latest pipelines. Pull to refresh.

PIPELINES AT A GLANCE
A compact feed of recent runs with status, pipeline number, trigger type, branch and commit. Drill in for the full picture.

WORKFLOWS AND JOBS
Browse every workflow in a pipeline, open the dependency graph, and dive into individual jobs - parallelism, resource class, timing and per-step outcomes.

REAL LOGS, ON THE GO
Read step-by-step output with exit codes, durations and timings. Failed a build on the train? Find out why before you reach a laptop.

TRIGGER, RERUN, CANCEL
Kick off a pipeline on any branch or tag, pass pipeline parameters, rerun a workflow from scratch or just from failed jobs, and cancel a runaway workflow or job with one tap.

CREDITS AND USAGE
Keep an eye on available credits for each org, plus success rates, total runs, duration and credit spend over 24-hour to 90-day windows.

MADE FOR ENGINEERS
• Personal access token sign-in; your token stays in the iOS Keychain
• Multi-org support with a quick org switcher
• Pull-to-refresh everywhere, with fast, resumable paging
• Native SwiftUI, dark-friendly and tuned for one-handed use

NOTE PocketCI is an unofficial client and is not affiliated with CircleCI. A CircleCI account and personal API token are required.
